latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of fairytale-dream-transform-video-gen-seedance2-0.

- Instantly transforms ideas or images into dreamy pastel videos using WeryAI Seedance 2.0.
- Mandatory prompt expansion into detailed, cinematic, and on-style English before each generation.
- Supports both text-to-video and single image-to-video (public https URLs only).
- Outputs vertical, healing, candy-soft short video links; full workflow and confirmation table built in.
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY, Node.js 18+, and video_gen.js/resources as documented.
- Only runs with the SEEDANCE_2_0 model and fixed API hosts; no other models or skills supported.
